name: Feeds Extensible Parsers XML Mapping
description: Extends XML parser with a mapping override per feed entity.
project_description:

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and the safety of Europe. 
 
 
 Extends XML parser with a mapping override per feed entity. It allows overriding XPath mapping on feed entities and no need to create separate feed types per XPath mapping.

 

 

 Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 
 Feeds Extensible Parsers 
 
 Installation 
 
 Download and enable as normal module 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Go to the feeds types page admin/structure/feeds . 
 Select the necessary feed type and go to Mapping . 
 Go to Override mapping per feed 
 Decide what kind of mapping overrides per feed you need: 
 
 Override source mapping 
 Override source mapping configuration 
 
 Mark necessary checkboxes and save mapping settings. 
 
 Project on github.com - feeds_ex_xml_mapping
